events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Classic album anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon: 46 years
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Tribute to a music legend
angles.copy: His music and message continue to resonate. Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on.

events.title: David Bowie would have turned 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a music icon
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. Celebrating the enduring genius of David Bowie.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have turned 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, born January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years since the birth of Elvis Presley. His legacy as the King of Rock & Roll lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the guitar god, Jimmy Page. Still influencing generations of rock musicians.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The one and only Sir Rod Stewart, born January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a music icon
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), born January 13, 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Two-tone legend
angles.copy: It's the 66th birthday of the one and only Suggs! Here's to the Madness frontman.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, born January 17, 1956, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat,' celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s icon
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home. Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, born January 19, 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Country icon
angles.copy: Jolene, Jolene, Jolene, Jolene, it's her birthday! Wishing Dolly Parton a very happy 81st.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and pop icon Gary Barlow, born January 20, 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop royalty
angles.copy: Fifty-six years old and still ruling the charts! Happy birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, born January 21, 1950, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Soulful legend
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going! Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first-ever induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Music history moment
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who's your dream inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born January 27, 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That member's birthday
angles.copy: Still got that boyband charm! Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert: 58 years
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public show on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: A legendary moment in music
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their final public performance. An iconic moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins, born January 30, 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Music icon's birthday
angles.copy: Against All Odds, he's 76! Happy birthday to the incredible Phil Collins.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake, born January 31, 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop icon's birthday
angles.copy: He's bringing SexyBack for his 46th! Happy birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, born February 2, 1940, known for his iconic TV roles, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a national treasure
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, music legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, a day forever known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: A somber day in music history
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop sensation Rick Astley, born February 6, 1966, famed for 'Never Gonna Give You Up,' celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never gonna give up on this legend
angles.copy: Never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down... Happy 61st birthday to the iconic Rick Astley!

events.title: Bob Marley would have turned 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born February 6, 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a global icon
angles.copy: One Love, one heart. Remembering the legendary Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, born February 9, 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Music royalty's birthday
angles.copy: You've Got a Friend in her! Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King, a true songwriting genius.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston: 15 years
events.blurb: It's 15 years since the world lost the incredible voice of Whitney Houston on February 11, 2012.

angles.name: A voice never forgotten
angles.copy: Fifteen years, and her voice still gives us chills. Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That's original split: 32 years
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the original Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: A day that broke hearts
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're Back For Good!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, born February 15, 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Reggae icon's birthday
angles.copy: Red Red Wine and 68 candles! Happy birthday to the voice of UB40, Ali Campbell.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, born February 17, 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy birthday to a modern legend
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud, it's Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday! Here's to many more hits.

events.title: George Harrison would have turned 84
events.blurb: The Quiet Beatle, George Harrison, born February 25, 1943, would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a musical genius
angles.copy: Here Comes The Sun, and it would have been George Harrison's 84th birthday. Remembering a true musical genius.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey, born March 1, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: Hope he doesn't get Fooled Again by too many candles! Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's Roger Daltrey.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop icon Nik Kershaw, born March 1, 1958, known for hits like 'Wouldn't It Be Good,' celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: 80s pop hero
angles.copy: Wouldn't it be good if we all looked this good at 69? Happy birthday to the fantastic Nik Kershaw!

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin, born March 2, 1977, celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Half a century of Coldplay's voice
angles.copy: Fifty years young for the voice of Coldplay! Happy birthday to Chris Martin.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock icon Jon Bon Jovi, born March 2, 1962, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock legend's birthday
angles.copy: Woah, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi.

events.title: Chris Rea would have turned 76
events.blurb: The soulful singer-songwriter Chris Rea, born March 4, 1951, would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering a smooth voice
angles.copy: Driving Home for Christmas and remembering the smooth voice of Chris Rea, who would have been 76 today.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have turned 83
events.blurb: The legendary Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, born March 6, 1944, would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Motown royalty
angles.copy: Stop! In the Name of Love, and remember Mary Wilson of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk debut: 44 years
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson first performed his iconic Moonwalk at Motown 25: Yesterday, Today, Forever.

angles.name: An iconic moment in pop culture
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago, MJ glided into history with the Moonwalk. A moment that changed pop culture forever.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan, born March 8, 1958, celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Electronic music pioneer
angles.copy: Are 'Friends' Electric? Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the innovative Gary Numan!
